control_failures.control_label: arc flash boundary and protective equipment
earth leakage and protection setting integrity
authorisation of switching and access to apparatus

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: uncontrolled movement of SG-4100 during routine operation

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the arc flash boundary and protective equipment on SG-4100 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. SG-4100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during routine operation while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 20 January 2025 an incident occurred on SG-4100 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during routine operation, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
